title: Close register
intro: Count cash, check receipts and review the closing.
localSave: Review saved on this computer only.
blind: Count first. Expected cash is shown after closing is confirmed.
splitHelp: One sale may contain several payments. Match each receipt to its payment, not the entire sale.
noPhotos: No photo or video is saved. Review fields before recording.
cameraFallback: If automatic reading is unavailable, enter the fields below. The camera remains available for checking.
reviewed: I checked these details against the receipt.
integratedHelp: Only confirmations received from the integration count. A photograph does not confirm payment.
noPapers: No receipts recorded for this closing.
confirmVoid: Void this receipt? Its record will be retained.
cashAuthority: Official expected cash includes opening cash, sales and cash movements, and is displayed after confirmation.
partial: Incomplete or unavailable query. Unknown values appear as a dash.
notSettlement: A checked receipt does not confirm bank settlement.
managerReview: I reviewed outstanding issues and authorize closing with a reason.
confirmFinal: Confirm closing with the counted cash? This action is sent to the register.
unsaved: There are unsaved changes. Leave this page?
noOCR: Automatic reading is unavailable in this browser. Enter and check the details.
storageError: Cannot access storage. Preserve your review before leaving.
conflict: Another window changed this review. Reopen before continuing.
sourceError: Could not retrieve all sales. Try refreshing.
cameraError: Cannot open camera. Check permission or enter details.
readError: Could not read. Adjust lighting and focus or enter details.
matchInvalid: This payment is already linked or does not match.
timeOrReferenceMismatch: Time or identification does not match.
reviewDifferences: Review payments and differences before closing.
